dedupe_keys.name: ladesaulen fur dienst kfz des offentlichen dienstes des freistaates sachsen

description: Ladesäulen für Dienst-Kfz des öffentlichen Dienstes des Freistaates Sachsen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The data contain the charging stations for electric mobility for all public service vehicles of the Free State of Saxony. In this dataset, the charging stations with corresponding charging power and location are bundled. The charging stations are exclusively located in authorities, colleges, universities and other facilities of the Free State of Saxony. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations for service vehicles of the public service of the Free State of Saxony" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Typ 2, Zapfsäule, E-mobility, Ladestation, Ladesäule, Elektromobilität. The listing shows 2026-01-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
